_readme: Per-portal harvest rules, keyed by source id (see `registry_info` or `find_sources`). Anything not listed uses the defaults.
`skip` means never call this portal, with the reason reported in every harvest's stats.
`cadence` sets how often each portal is read. `publish_gate` sets when the harvest workflow refuses to publish a new index (see README, "The nightly harvest").

defaults.esri_org_ids_note: Only org ids seen live are listed (P3ePLMYs2RVChkJx: Esri's own national layers on Monroe's portal, probe 6, 2026-11-05). Items owned by another org are excluded from a portal anyway (see own-org rule), so this list is a second guard, not the main one.

by_entity.Association for Neighborhood and Housing: Account-gated portal with a data-access policy. Never called.
by_entity.Rockland County: Blocks automated clients (Scout eval, 2026-11-05). Skipped; never worked around.
by_entity.Columbia University Libraries: GeoBlacklight with 104,570 records, mostly not New York. Excluded from the harvest.

cadence._note: Days between reads. Self-hosted county ArcGIS servers (the `enterprise` adapter) are read weekly, to be gentle on small county servers (epic #7, decision D5). Everything else nightly. A portal is due `slack_hours` early so a late scheduled start does not slip a whole week. `harvest --ignore-cadence` reads everything.

publish_gate._note: The workflow publishes only when every check passes (or a person overrides it with a written reason, which is recorded in gate.json, index.json and the release notes). Compared with the index that is published now. Portals the harvest drops because their ids left the registry are subtracted before the drop checks, up to max_registry_removed_portals of them.
